title: Little Artist
shareTitle: Little Artist — Make It Your Way
description: Choose treasures, draw yarn trails, and make an artwork all your own. A gentle open-ended art table for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Spatial composition through choosing, layering, rotating, and sizing
Continuous fine-motor path planning with loops, curves, and crossings
Intentional visual storytelling from an open-ended spoken prompt
interactionModel: Custom mixed-media workbench: drag or tap authored craft pieces onto paper, transform them with accessible tools, and draw textured yarn trails with one pointer.
feedbackModel: Tactile pops and gentle fiber sounds acknowledge every placement or stroke; Teddy offers spoken invitations and celebrates intent without scores, correction, or comparison.
